address: A1-10, Well Well, 55 Xueyuan West Road, Lucheng, Wenzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: Located in a bustling part of the city, this cosy restaurant has enjoyed substantial success almost since it opened. The seafood displayed in the live fish tanks at the entrance is superlative. In addition to signatures like seaweed sausage and fish cake, also try the steamed crab with pork belly strips and fermented shrimp paste: the porky richness deftly complements the seafood umami. Sensible prices are another strong selling point.
